QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_73

question.text: Akash, a CA, is reviewing a Cat III AIF's PPM. Which of the following disclosures should he verify for fee transparency?

answer.text: Year-wise illustration of fees & expenses AND Distribution Waterfall

explanation.text: The Logic: Fee transparency is covered in the 'Illustrations of Fees, Expenses and Other Charges' section and the Distribution Waterfall. The Trap: Sector/geography is strategy info; personal holdings/KYC are separate. Cross-Exam Context: Same disclosure requirements across Cat I/II (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: As a CA, walk your client through these two sections line-by-line before they commit.
